PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.content: We take your privacy seriously. This policy explains what data we collect when you use this site, why we collect it, and how we handle it securely.

analytics.title: 2. Analytics
analytics.content: We use privacy-focused analytics tools like Plausible or Vercel Analytics to understand general usage of this website. These tools do not use cookies and do not track personal data. All data is aggregated and anonymized.

contactForm.title: 3. Contact Form
contactForm.content1: When you fill out the contact form to start a project or get in touch, we collect the information you provide (such as your name, email address, and message). This data is used solely to respond to your inquiry and is not shared or used for marketing purposes.
contactForm.content2: The form data may be temporarily processed by a third-party service (e.g. Formspree, Resend, EmailJS), which adheres to modern data protection standards.

dataSharing.title: 4. Data Sharing
dataSharing.content: We do not sell or rent your personal information. We only share data with service providers required to operate this site (such as analytics or form handling), under strict confidentiality agreements.

rights.title: 5. Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data. To do so, please contact us at the email below.
